name: Monitor YouTube channels for new uploads, summarize transcripts with AI & send to Slack + Sheets

parameters.content:
## Monitor YouTube channels for new uploads, summarize transcripts with AI & send to Slack + Sheets

### How it works

This workflow receives signed webhook notifications from YT to Text Watchlists when a monitored YouTube channel publishes a new video and its transcript is ready, verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature, and rejects unauthorized requests. For valid notifications, it cleans and caps the transcript, sends it to OpenAI for summarization, then formats the result for delivery. The final brief is posted to Slack, archived in Google Sheets, and the webhook receives a success response.

### Setup steps

- Create a channel Watchlist on YT to Text (https://yttotext.com/youtube-channel-monitor) and paste this workflow's Production webhook URL.
- Copy the Watchlist webhook secret (whsec_...) and set `YTTOTEXT_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in n8n (or update the Verify Signature node).
- Add OpenAI credentials and confirm the summarization model/prompt settings in the OpenAI node.
- Connect Slack credentials and choose the target channel for brief posts.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheet, sheet, and column mapping for archived briefs.

### Customization

Adjust the transcript cleaning/capping logic, OpenAI summary prompt, Slack message format, and Google Sheets columns to match the desired brief style and reporting needs.

## Receive and authenticate

Accepts incoming watchlist webhook calls, verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature, and immediately returns a 401 response for invalid requests.

## Prepare and summarize transcript

Cleans and limits the transcript text, then sends it to OpenAI to generate a concise summary of the new YouTube upload.

## Format delivery brief

Transforms the AI summary and video metadata into formatted payloads suitable for both Slack and Google Sheets.

## Send and archive brief

Posts the formatted brief to Slack, appends the record to Google Sheets, and returns a 200 OK webhook response after the Slack delivery path completes.
